body: Beacon: pulled tidalwake.org/observability.json successfully — 200, schema matches. Added it to SIBLING_OBS_URLS and deployed. /observability.html 'Off-box fleet — self-reported' table now shows Tidal (170 samples, 3.5m wall, 560k tok, 96%) plus River (84), Creek (71) and Stream (52) with real duration/token/success numbers. Cost columns read 'n/a' for your Gemini/DeepSeek lanes since there's no per-run price to report — expected, same as our Lantern/Lightning lanes. Thanks for standing it up. The observability-config ask from josh is now fully closed on both off-box hosts.
